note: Re-quoted 2026-11-25 to the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0; library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz, read offline as owb-am), per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 (Amharic quotes OWB everywhere). This supersedes what the notes below say about the 1962 UBS Bible and about wording reused from other shipped works: every `mined` row is now a verbatim OWB span in its block (exact OWB pieces may be joined with '…'; OWB's closing '፤' may end a quotation as '።'). The self_rendered rows are Hyde's or the reader's own words built round a verse (re-personed or turned into a prayer), noted one by one.

Scripture authority is the 1962 Amharic Bible (UBS; NT revised 2003). Its New Testament is on disk whole (ebible mirror gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/amh_amh; re-verified for this job 2026-10-09: all 27 NT books return 200 as usfm/, gen/psa/isa 404). The mirror carries no Old Testament, so OT quotations reuse the wording of an already-shipped Amharic work where one quotes the same verse (source_file names it) and are otherwise self_rendered in the 1962 register.
Every `mined` row was checked mechanically against the finished text: the quoted Amharic is an exact substring of the 1962 NT verse (USFM on disk) or of the cited corpus file, inside the block named.

The English epigraphs are child-sized excerpts ("— from Matthew 9"); per the shipped am children's editions each quotes the Bible's own wording for the part the English means, with … for words left out, and cites `— ከ<Book> <chapter>`. Isaiah 6:8 is quoted whole (daughters-of-the-king-3.am.json) although the English drops "who will go for us". Psalm 51:10a («አቤቱ፥ ንጹሕ ልብን ፍጠርልኝ») matches the wording of the shipped article what-is-repentance.am.json, which the mined-verification gate cannot open (articles are outside its census), so it ships self_rendered. Psalm 81:10b matches the-life-of-trust-children.am.json.

Self-rendered: chapter 2's closing prayer echoes Isaiah 6:8b in a child's voice («እነሆኝ፤ ላከኝ»). Chapter 10 re-persons Zechariah 2:8 to "him" as Hyde heard it («እርሱን የሚነካ የዓይኔን ብሌን ይነካል»; the plural form is in enduring-persecution-for-christ.am.json), alludes to Revelation 12:10 ("accuser of the brethren", «የወንድሞች ከሳሽ»; 1962 has «የወንድሞቻችን ከሳሽ»), and turns Philippians 4:8 into Hyde's own prayer.

Clock times keep the English hour number with Western digits ("ጠዋት 8 ሰዓት ... ከሰዓት በኋላ 3 ሰዓት ተኩል", chapter 8), the majority convention in the shipped am books (religious-experience-and-journal.am); a native reviewer may prefer Ethiopian reckoning (ጠዋት 2 ሰዓት / 9 ሰዓት ተኩል).
Names follow men-who-moved-heaven.am.json chapter 8 (ጆን ኔልሰን ሃይድ, «ጸሎተኛው ሃይድ», ፑንጃብ, ሲያልኮት, ኢሊኖይ). Hyde's Punjabi last words are transliterated into Ge'ez («ቦል፣ ዪሱ መሲሕ፣ ኪ ጃይ!»).
